landing.businessBody: Your own booking page, calendar, staff schedules, payments, reminders and analytics — set up in minutes.

faq.q: Do I need an account to book?
faq.a: Not always. Many businesses allow guest bookings — you’ll get a booking reference to manage it later. With an account you get history, favourites and reminders in one place.

faq.q: How do I cancel or reschedule?
faq.a: From your account or the Track booking page. Each business sets its own cancellation window, which is shown before you confirm.
Online payments are processed by our payment provider; card details never touch our servers. You can also choose to pay at the location when the business allows it.
